DGFT Enables Automated Issuance of Free Sale and Commerce Certificates to Promote Ease of Doing Business
summary: The Directorate General of Foreign Trade (DGFT) has introduced automated issuance of Free Sale and Commerce Certificates (FSC) on its portal for eligible exporters, bypassing manual scrutiny by Regional Authorities. FSCs are issued under the Foreign Trade Policy for items not covered under the Drugs & Cosmetics Act, 1940. Applications needing verification will still be routed for manual processing, and some auto-approved cases may be flagged later for risk-based review.

title: India–Denmark Strengthen Bilateral Cooperation in MSME Development, Innovation & Intellectual Property
summary: The 4th India–Denmark Joint Working Group meeting was held in Copenhagen from 24-28 August 2026 between India's Ministry of MSME and the Danish Patent and Trademark Office (DKPTO) to deepen bilateral cooperation on MSME development, innovation and intellectual property. The Indian delegation, led by Additional Secretary & Development Commissioner Dr. Rajneesh, visited Danish innovation hubs, met the Danish Ministry of Industry, Business and Financial Affairs, and participated in the Nordic-India Startup Summit 2026. Discussions covered technology adoption, IP, cluster-based MSME development and future areas of collaboration under the JWG framework.

title: Prime Minister congratulates the nation on achieving 7.8% GDP growth; highlights surging economic confidence
summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi congratulated the nation after India recorded a GDP growth rate of 7.8% in the first quarter of the financial year. In a video message and a post on social media platform X, he described the figures as reflecting surging economic confidence, using the phrase 'Strong numbers. Even stronger confidence.'

title: SURGEON VICE ADMIRAL MANISH HONWAD, VSM ASSUMED THE APPOINTMENT OF DIRECTOR & COMMANDANT OF THE ARMED FORCES MEDICAL COLLEGE, PUNE
summary: Surgeon Vice Admiral Manish Honwad, VSM, assumed charge as Director and Commandant of the Armed Forces Medical College (AFMC), Pune on 1 September 2026. He is an AFMC alumnus with an MD in Anaesthesiology and Critical Care Medicine, a WHO Fellowship from NIMHANS, and prior appointments including Additional Director General Medical Services (Navy) and Commanding Officer of INHS Sanjivani and INHS Asvini. He was conferred the Vishisht Seva Medal in 2025 along with several other commendations during his 37-year career.

title: Indian Railways Approves ₹233 Crore for Electronic Interlocking at 21 Stations in Samastipur Division
summary: Indian Railways has sanctioned ₹233 crore to replace the existing Panel Interlocking system with modern Electronic Interlocking (EI) at 21 stations in the Samastipur Division of East Central Railway. The upgrade will modernise signalling infrastructure and support the rollout of Kavach, India's indigenous Automatic Train Protection (ATP) system, at these stations.

title: Indian Railways Approves ₹272 Crore Bypass Line Between Adra and Joychandipahar to Boost Freight Capacity
summary: Indian Railways has sanctioned an 11 km bypass line between Adra and Joychandipahar on South Eastern Railway at a cost of ₹272 crore. The bypass, part of the Energy, Mineral and Cement Corridor, aims to ease congestion, support freight movement for SAIL and BCCL, and add 8.88 MTPA capacity by 2028-29.

title: Indian Railways Approves ₹170 Crore for Kavach 4.0 on Remaining 712 Rkm of Moradabad Division
summary: Indian Railways has sanctioned ₹170 crore to extend Kavach Version 4.0, the indigenous Automatic Train Protection (ATP) system, to the remaining 712 route kilometres of the Moradabad Division under Northern Railway. This is part of the ongoing nationwide rollout of Kavach to enhance train safety by preventing collisions and Signal Passing at Danger (SPAD) incidents.

title: Prime Minister shares a Sanskrit Subhashitam, highlighting the qualities of a truly wise person
summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi shared a Sanskrit Subhashitam (aphorism) on X on 1 September 2026, describing the qualities of a truly wise person as one whose plans remain hidden until execution. The PIB release simply reproduces the verse and its translation with no policy content.

title: Mission Zero: Depalpur Triumphs in Tackling Legacy Waste
summary: Depalpur Nagar Parishad, mentored by Indore Municipal Corporation under the 'Swachh Shehar Jodi' initiative of Swachh Bharat Mission-Urban 2.0, has become the first city to achieve 'Zero Legacy Waste' by remediating 1,250 metric tonnes of waste accumulated over five years. The operation recovered 4.5 tonnes of recyclables and sent 50-60 tonnes of Refuse Derived Fuel to Indore's NEPRA plant for co-processing in cement factories, and the reclaimed dumpsite is being converted into a green public space. The release also highlights that 72 mentor cities and 200 mentee cities have undertaken over 1,600 activities under this 100-day, 'Each One Teach One' mentorship framework launched during Swachhata Hi Seva 2025.

title: 4th Indo-German Environmental Forum to be held in New Delhi on September 1, 2026

ministry.name: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change

summary: The 4th Indo-German Environmental Forum, themed 'Together For More Resilience', was held in New Delhi on September 1, 2026, co-chaired by India's Environment Minister Bhupender Yadav and Germany's Environment Minister Carsten Schneider. The forum, the highest-level bilateral platform on environmental policy between the two countries since 2008, focused on low-carbon industries, biodiversity, circular economy, and sustainable finance. It was preceded by meetings of three Joint Working Groups on Climate Change, Biodiversity, and Circular Economy.

title: Raksha Rajya Mantri to inaugurate second Annual Trident Lecture of CENJOWS
summary: Raksha Rajya Mantri Sanjay Seth will inaugurate the second Annual Trident Lecture of the Centre for Joint Warfare Studies (CENJOWS) at Manekshaw Centre, New Delhi, on September 1, 2026, themed 'National Resurgence through the Lens of Defence Forces'. The event will feature addresses by senior military leaders including the CISC Chairman Air Marshal Tejinder Singh, Lt Gen Raj Shukla (Retd), and Vice Chief of Army Staff Lt Gen Sandeep Jain on topics like jointness, civil-military fusion, and multi-domain operations.

title: Raksha Mantri to undertake annual performance review of 16 DPSUs in New Delhi
summary: Raksha Mantri Rajnath Singh will conduct the annual performance review of India's 16 Defence Public Sector Undertakings (DPSUs) in New Delhi on 1 September 2026. Seven DPSUs - HAL, MDL, BEL, BDL, GRSE, BEML and MIDHANI - will present FY2025-26 dividend cheques, and four books on DPSU self-reliance, student outreach (DISHA) and HAL's modernisation/indigenisation roadmaps will be released. DPSUs reported a combined turnover of Rs 1.29 lakh crore (up 15.4%), Profit After Tax of Rs 23,136 crore (up 15.6%), and a 151.2% surge in exports over the previous year.

title: Cyber-Physical Systems
summary: This PIB backgrounder explains Cyber-Physical Systems (CPS) — technologies that integrate computing, communication and physical processes — and details India's National Mission on Interdisciplinary Cyber-Physical Systems (NM-ICPS), a Department of Science and Technology scheme approved by the Cabinet in 2018 with a ₹3,660 crore outlay over nine years. As of August 2026, the Mission has set up 25 Technology Innovation Hubs and four Technology Translation Research Parks (at IIT Kanpur, IISc Bengaluru, IIT-ISM Dhanbad and IIT Indore), enabled 1,146 technologies and 1,329 technology products, awarded 5,824 CHANAKYA fellowships, trained over 2.46 lakh professionals, incubated 1,136 start-ups creating 24,000+ jobs, and forged 200 international collaborations. It also highlights BharatGen's sovereign multilingual AI models and sector-specific CPS applications in healthcare, agriculture, mining, communications, cybersecurity and mobility.

title: Commerce Secretary Shri Rajesh Agrawal Co-Chairs India-Brazil 8th Trade Monitoring Mechanism Meeting
summary: The 8th India-Brazil Trade Monitoring Mechanism meeting was held in Brasília, co-chaired by Commerce Secretary Rajesh Agrawal and Brazil's Secretary of Foreign Trade Tatiana Lacerda Prazeres. Both sides reaffirmed a target of USD 30 billion in bilateral trade by 2030 (up from USD 15.07 billion in 2025-26), reviewed the India-MERCOSUR Terms of Reference for PTA expansion, and discussed pharmaceutical market access via the CDSCO-ANVISA MoU. A High-Level Business Reception in Brasília featured over 25 Indian companies including Kirloskar Group, UPL and Aditya Birla Group.

title: Joint Statement during the State Visit of Prime Minister Narendra Modi to Uzbekistan
summary: During PM Narendra Modi's State Visit to Uzbekistan (29-30 August 2026), he and President Shavkat Mirziyoyev issued a Joint Statement agreeing to elevate India-Uzbekistan relations to a 'Comprehensive Strategic Partnership'. The statement covers cooperation across political-security ties, counter-terrorism, trade and investment (including progress on a Preferential Trade Agreement feasibility study), critical minerals, nuclear energy, agriculture, transport connectivity, and digital/space technology, including continuation of the Joint Military Exercise 'Dustlik' and the Central Asia-India summit format.

title: Prime Minister Conferred with “Oliy Darajali Do’stlik” Order, Uzbekistan’s highest honour for foreign leaders
summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi was conferred with Uzbekistan's highest honour for foreign leaders, the "Oliy Darajali Do'stlik" Order (Order of Highest Friendship), by President Shavkat Mirziyoyev, in recognition of his contribution to strengthening India-Uzbekistan friendship. Modi dedicated the honour to India's 1.4 billion citizens, calling it a symbol of enduring civilisational ties, and pledged deeper cooperation as Global South partners.

title: Prime Minister holds official talks on his State Visit to Uzbekistan
summary: During PM Modi's State Visit to Uzbekistan, he and President Shavkat Mirziyoyev held bilateral talks and decided to elevate their Strategic Partnership to a Comprehensive Strategic Partnership. They set a bilateral trade target of USD 5 billion by 2030, agreed to establish a Foreign Ministers-led mechanism and raise the Inter-Governmental Commission to ministerial level, and signed multiple MoUs covering culture, education, mining, environment and tourism. India also announced a USD 1 million grant for Aral Sea rehabilitation and a Lal Bahadur Shastri Scholarship for Hindi language studies in Uzbekistan.

title: List of Outcomes: Prime Minister’s State Visit to Uzbekistan
summary: During Prime Minister's state visit to Uzbekistan, India and Uzbekistan signed 11 MoUs/agreements covering culture, archaeology, Ayurveda, mining, tourism, education, finance, environment and a Gujarat-Samarkand partnership. Both sides also announced elevation of their Strategic Partnership to a Comprehensive Strategic Partnership, a USD 1 million grant for Aral Sea afforestation, Hindi language scholarships, a Sanskrit chair, and a UPI-UZQR interoperability agreement for cross-border digital payments.

title: Prime Minister's press statement during the joint press statement with the President of Uzbekistan
summary: During Prime Minister Modi's visit to Uzbekistan (his fourth), India and Uzbekistan upgraded their ties from a Strategic Partnership (marking 15 years) to a Comprehensive Strategic Partnership. The two sides set a bilateral trade target of USD 5 billion by 2030 (up from the current USD 1 billion), and agreed to expand cooperation in defence co-production, digital public infrastructure, AI, critical minerals, clean energy, space, nuclear energy, traditional medicine, agriculture, tourism, and city/state-level partnerships. Agreements were also announced on Traditional Medicine, a tourism Program of Cooperation, Hindi-language scholarships, and preservation of Uzbekistan's Buddhist heritage sites.

title: Vice President inaugurates Aranmula Uthrittathi Vallamkali, celebrates Keralam’s rich cultural heritage
summary: Vice President C. P. Radhakrishnan inaugurated the Aranmula Uthrittathi Vallamkali boat race on the River Pamba, calling it a symbol of Keralam's cultural heritage and devotion. He referenced the recent State Renaming Bill passed during his tenure as Rajya Sabha Chairman, spoke of the spiritual significance of Sabarimala and the GI-tagged Aranmula Kannadi, and invoked PM Modi's 'Vikas Bhi, Virasat Bhi' vision. The event was attended by the Kerala Governor and several state ministers.

title: Integrated Fertilizer Management System (iFMS) Enters a New Phase of Data-Driven Fertilizer Management

ministry.name: Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilizers :Department of Fertilizers

summary: The Department of Fertilizers has expanded the Integrated Fertilizer Management System (iFMS), India's digital backbone for fertilizer subsidy and supply-chain management, with new features including integration with farmer/land databases (Meri Fasal Mera Byora and AgriStack), a Framework for Fertilizer Sale (FFS) mobile booking system, Vehicle Location Tracking System (VLTS), and enhanced electronic subsidy processing linked to PFMS/e-Bill systems. iFMS currently covers over 14 crore Aadhaar-linked buyers, more than 2.5 lakh retailers, around 7 crore metric tonnes of annual fertilizer sales, and administers nearly ₹2 lakh crore in annual fertilizer subsidy. These upgrades aim to move iFMS from mere transaction recording toward a data-driven decision-support platform linking production, movement, retail sale and consumption with agricultural context.

title: Dr. Jitendra Singh holds Interaction with the delegation of Armed Forces HQ Association; Discussions Focus on Promotions and Pending Service-Related Issues

ministry.name: Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances & Pensions

summary: Union Minister Dr. Jitendra Singh met a delegation of the Armed Forces HQ Association to discuss employee demands relating to promotions, career progression and other pending service matters. The delegation submitted a memorandum, and the Minister assured that the representations would be examined in consultation with relevant stakeholder departments. The delegation acknowledged DoPT's recent efforts to reduce stagnation and improve employee morale.

title: NEET-PG 2026 Successfully Conducted Nationwide with Robust Security and Real-Time Monitoring

ministry.name: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare

summary: NBEMS successfully conducted the NEET-PG 2026 examination on 30 August 2026 across 1,111 centres in 339 cities in all 36 States/UTs, with 2,65,980 of 2,73,096 scheduled candidates appearing. A technical disruption due to power supply issues at two Sitapura centres in Jaipur affected 2,445 candidates, whose exam has been rescheduled for 5 September 2026.

title: Raksha Mantri & UP Chief Minister perform Bhoomi Pujan for 14 development projects worth over Rs 100 crore at Lucknow Cantonment
summary: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh and UP CM Yogi Adityanath performed Bhoomi Pujan for 14 development projects worth over Rs 100 crore at Lucknow Cantonment, covering water supply, education, healthcare, sports, sanitation and civic amenities. Two of the projects are being implemented jointly with the state government. The dignitaries also listened to PM Modi's 'Mann ki Baat' with around 4,000 people, and several Cantonment markets with British-era names were renamed after Indian freedom fighters and leaders.

title: Vice President Shri C. P. Radhakrishnan attends 115th Anniversary Celebrations of Kerala Kaumudi
summary: Vice President C. P. Radhakrishnan attended the 115th anniversary celebrations of the Malayalam newspaper Kerala Kaumudi in Alappuzha, praising its legacy of social awakening since its founding in 1911 by C. V. Kunhiraman. He called for credible, constructive and responsible journalism in the AI era, emphasizing public trust as a newspaper's greatest asset, and also congratulated Keralam on its recent official name change. He presented the Kerala Kaumudi Excellence Awards at the event.

title: Union Minister Dr. Mansukh Mandaviya leads 88th Edition of Fit India Sundays on Cycle at BRICS Run & Ride 2026 in New Delhi

ministry.name: Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports

summary: Union Sports Minister Dr. Mansukh Mandaviya led the 88th edition of Fit India Sundays on Cycle at Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium, New Delhi, held simultaneously at over 25,000 locations nationwide. This edition, tied to the BRICS Run & Ride 2026 initiative, was dedicated to BRICS delegates ahead of the 18th BRICS Summit at Bharat Mandapam on September 12-13, and saw participation from cricketer Gautam Gambhir, wrestler Sangram Singh, actor Madhurima Tuli, and envoys from several BRICS partner nations.

title: English rendering of PM’s address in the 137th Episode of Mann Ki Baat on 30.08.2026
summary: In the 137th episode of Mann Ki Baat (30 August 2026), PM Modi highlighted a citizen-built history website (bharatrajya.com) by Krishna Seshadri that maps historical rulers by year and region, discussed the 'Nasha-Mukt Yuva for Viksit Bharat' anti-drug campaign, described August's patriotic events including the 'Suryapath Tiranga' global flag-hoisting initiative and 8 crore Tiranga selfies, and spotlighted women's empowerment through PM SVANidhi Yojana, noting that women constitute about 46% of beneficiaries (around 35 lakh women) with success stories from Ghaziabad and Bengaluru.

title: Department of Consumer Affairs Notifies Legal Metrology (Indian Standard Time) Rules, 2026

ministry.name: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food & Public Distribution

summary: The Department of Consumer Affairs notified the Legal Metrology (Indian Standard Time) Rules, 2026 on 27 August 2026, which will come into force 180 days after Gazette publication. The Rules mandate Indian Standard Time (IST) as the common time reference for legal, administrative, commercial and official purposes across banking, telecommunications, railways, power systems and government records. They also provide for use of NavIC and other Indian timing sources for secure time dissemination, reducing dependence on foreign satellite-based time systems, building on a White Rabbit Technology-based IST dissemination demonstration commissioned at RRSL Bengaluru in July 2026 under the 'One Nation, One Time' initiative.

title: Hon’ble Vice President of India to Release “Mission Rangeen Machhli 2031” Strategic Action Plan for Ornamental Fisheries Development

ministry.name: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry & Dairying

summary: The Vice President of India released the 'Mission Rangeen Machhli 2031' Strategic Action Plan for Ornamental Fisheries Development at an Outreach Programme of the Department of Fisheries held in Agatti, Lakshadweep on 31 August 2026. The plan sets out a uniform national framework covering broodstock management, breeding, hatchery operations, quarantine, health management, traceability, and trade standards for the ornamental fisheries value chain. The event also highlighted Lakshadweep's designation as a dedicated Seaweed Cluster and its untapped marine and tuna fisheries potential as part of India's blue economy push.

title: India–Chile CEPA Negotiations Advance; Commerce Secretary Shri Rajesh Agrawal Meets Chilean Vice-Minister Paula Estévez Weinstein
summary: Commerce Secretary Rajesh Agrawal met Chile's Vice-Minister of International Economic Relations, Paula Estévez Weinstein, in Santiago on 26 August 2026 to advance negotiations on the India–Chile Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA). Both sides aim to conclude the CEPA by the end of the year, targeting deeper cooperation in healthcare, pharmaceuticals, energy, minerals, agriculture, and engineering. The agreement is expected to expand trade, investment, technology and supply-chain cooperation between the two Global South economies.

title: India's Higher Education Sector
summary: This PIB backgrounder presents a decade-long (2014-15 to 2023-24) overview of India's higher education sector based on AISHE data, highlighting growth in institutions, enrolment, and inclusion under NEP 2020. Universities grew 69.6% to 1,289, enrolment rose 31.5% to 4.50 crore, and Gross Enrolment Ratio (GER) increased from 23.7% to 30%. Female GER (31.2%) surpassed male GER for the seventh consecutive year, and Gender Parity Index improved to 1.08, alongside gains in SC/ST/OBC participation, STEM enrolment, foreign student numbers, and faculty strength.

title: President of India to Grace NIFT Combined Convocation 2026 Tomorrow in New Delhi
summary: President Droupadi Murmu, as official Visitor of NIFT, will be Chief Guest at the NIFT Combined Convocation 2026 on 31 August 2026 in New Delhi, bringing together graduating students from 18 NIFT campuses. Union Textiles Minister Giriraj Singh and other dignitaries will also attend, with gold medals awarded to top CGPA holders across programmes, followed by campus-wise degree distribution ceremonies.

title: Acquire knowledge, question injustice through constitutional means & bring about change through democratic methods: Raksha Mantri to youth
summary: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh addressed a convocation at Babasaheb Bhimrao Ambedkar University, Lucknow, invoking Dr Ambedkar's 'Educate, Agitate, Organise' philosophy to urge youth to pursue constitutional rather than violent means for social change. He called on students to become job creators and contribute to 'Viksit Bharat by 2047', citing progress in R&D spending, the National Education Policy, space missions, and India's start-up ecosystem.

title: Union Sports Minister Dr Mansukh Mandaviya leads National Sports Day celebrations at Major Dhyan Chand National Stadium

ministry.name: Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports

summary: Union Sports Minister Dr Mansukh Mandaviya led National Sports Day celebrations at the Major Dhyan Chand National Stadium in New Delhi, marking the 121st birth anniversary of hockey legend Major Dhyan Chand. The event centred on the 'Ek Ghanta Khel Ke Maidan Mein' initiative, urging citizens to spend at least one hour daily on sports and fitness as part of the Fit India Movement. Activities included cricket, football and tug of war, with participation from ministers, officials, media and influencers.

title: Water-Smart Farming with Per Drop More Crop
summary: This PIB backgrounder details the Per Drop More Crop (PDMC) scheme, which promotes drip and sprinkler micro-irrigation to improve agricultural water use efficiency. As of July 2026, PDMC has covered over 115 lakh hectares (about 8.11% of India's net sown area), with ₹8,123.24 crore in central assistance released over three years and 12.30 lakh farmers benefitted in 2025-26 alone. The release traces PDMC's evolution from a 2006 scheme through PMKSY to its current status as a component of the restructured Pradhan Mantri Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana (PM-RKVY) since 2022-23, and cites NITI Aayog, Economic Survey 2020-21, and IIM Ahmedabad studies showing gains in yields, incomes, and water/energy savings.

title: Revised CBG pricing supports producers without materially impacting consumers
summary: The Ministry of Petroleum & Natural Gas clarified that the revised procurement price for Compressed Biogas (CBG) under the GOBARdhan Scheme, set at ₹2,110 per MMBtu (up from ₹1,478), will not be fully passed on to CNG and PNG consumers. After factoring in ₹215 per MMBtu of government-funded affordability support, the effective cost to be recovered from consumers is about ₹1,895 per MMBtu, a 28% rise rather than 43%. Additionally, since CBG costs will now be pooled across a domestic gas base 2.5-3 times larger than before, the release states the per-consumer price impact will be negligible.

title: Prime Minister extends greetings on National Sports Day
summary: On National Sports Day (29 August, Major Dhyan Chand's birth anniversary), Prime Minister Narendra Modi extended greetings to sports lovers, praising athletes' dedication and passion, and paid tribute to hockey legend Major Dhyan Chand.

title: Commerce Secretary Shri Rajesh Agrawal Leads 4th India–Argentina JTC Meeting; Both Sides Reaffirm Commitment to Deepen Strategic and Economic Partnership
summary: The 4th India–Argentina Joint Trade Committee (JTC) meeting was held in Buenos Aires on 24 August 2026, led by Commerce Secretary Rajesh Agrawal and Argentina's Ambassador Fernando Brun, reviewing progress on cooperation in lithium mining, energy, agriculture, pharmaceuticals and digital technology. Bilateral trade crossed USD 6.5 billion in 2025 with over 17% annual growth, making India Argentina's fifth-largest trading partner. Key outcomes included progress on KABIL's lithium mining Phase II drilling in Catamarca, SPS talks for Indian agri exports, Argentina's commitment to upgrade India's pharma regulatory status, and a Business Forum featuring the largest-ever Indian business delegation to Argentina.

title: Text of PM’s Departure Statement ahead of visit to Uzbekistan and Kyrgyz Republic
summary: Prime Minister Modi is undertaking a visit to Uzbekistan and the Kyrgyz Republic from 29 August to 1 September 2026. In Tashkent, he will hold a State Visit with President Mirziyoyev to deepen the India-Uzbekistan Strategic Partnership and visit cultural landmarks. He will then travel to Bishkek to attend the 26th SCO Summit, marking 25 years of the organisation, and the Opening Ceremony of the 6th World Nomad Games.

title: Visit of Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi to Uzbekistan and Kyrgyz Republic (29 August-1 September 2026)
summary: PM Narendra Modi will undertake a State Visit to Uzbekistan on 29-30 August 2026, followed by participation in the 26th SCO Summit in Bishkek, Kyrgyz Republic, from 31 August to 1 September 2026. In Tashkent he will hold talks with President Mirziyoyev covering trade, defence, connectivity, energy and education, and visit the Shastri Memorial and Mahatma Gandhi Centre. At the SCO Summit, marking the organisation's 25th anniversary, Modi will highlight India's priorities of Security, Connectivity and Opportunity and hold bilateral meetings with SCO leaders, and will also attend the opening of the 6th World Nomad Games.

title: PARIVARTAN Scheme gains momentum: 1,300+ beneficiaries registered, 42 Banks/NBFCs and 15 auto OEMs onboarded across Delhi-NCR
summary: The Ministry of Road Transport & Highways reported progress on the PARIVARTAN Scheme, approved by the Union Cabinet on 3 June 2026 to replace over 2 lakh BS-IV or older trucks and buses in Delhi-NCR with BS-VI/electric vehicles. As of 27 August 2026, over 1,300 beneficiaries have registered on the scheme's portal, with 42 banks/NBFCs onboarded for loan interest subvention and 15 auto OEMs signing MoUs to offer purchase discounts. The scheme, launched on 14 July 2026, has a total outlay of ₹9,585 crore (₹5,041 crore central budgetary support) and offers interest savings, road tax and registration fee waivers, OEM discounts, and fuel vouchers or one-time EV incentives.

title: Union Health Ministry Reviews Progress Towards Achieving Malaria Elimination Target by 2030

ministry.name: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare

summary: The Union Health Ministry, through NHM Mission Director Aradhana Patnaik, reviewed India's progress toward the SDG target of malaria elimination by 2030. Between 2015 and 2025, malaria cases and deaths fell by nearly 80%, high-burden districts dropped from 155 to 33, and 160 districts reported zero indigenous cases during 2022-2025. The review focused on the remaining 33 high-burden districts across nine states/UTs, which accounted for 64% of cases and 54% of deaths in 2025, and stressed strengthening surveillance, the Test-Treat-Track strategy, and intersectoral convergence.

title: From Private Driver to Self-Employed Autorickshaw Owner: How NBCFDC Support Transformed Sunil Kumar K.P.’s Livelihood
summary: This PIB release is a human-interest success story about Sunil Kumar K.P., an OBC Thiyya community member from Kerala, who used a ₹2.69 lakh term loan from NBCFDC (channelled via the Kerala State Backward Classes Development Corporation) in 2022 to buy an autorickshaw. His monthly income rose from ₹5,000 as a private driver to about ₹20,000 as a self-employed autorickshaw owner.

title: From Financial Struggle to Mechanised Sanitation Entrepreneurship: How NAMASTE–SUY Support Strengthened Kapil Pal’s Livelihood
summary: This PIB release is a beneficiary success story highlighting Kapil Pal, a sanitation worker from Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh, who received support under the Swachhta Udyami Yojana (SUY) component of the NAMASTE Scheme in September 2021. With a capital subsidy of ₹3.47 lakh and a loan of ₹5.42 lakh, he purchased a tractor-cum-suction machine and now earns ₹35,000-40,000 per month providing mechanised sewer and septic tank services under Nagar Nigam Ghaziabad.

title: Union Minister of Communications Shri Jyotiraditya M. Scindia Hails Sanchar Saathi’s Record Recovery of Over 75,000 Lost and Stolen Mobile Handsets in a Single Month Across India
summary: The Department of Telecommunications' Sanchar Saathi initiative recovered over 75,000 lost or stolen mobile handsets across India in a single month for the first time since its launch. Union Minister Jyotiraditya Scindia credited this to enhanced coordination between DoT, telecom service providers, and state/UT police, along with system upgrades like sharing police station details and SIM insertion data with authorities. Monthly handset recoveries rose 201% between April 2025 and July 2026.

title: Vice President Shri C. P. Radhakrishnan launches ‘Gnani Artha’, a sovereign AI stack comprising Evon 3.3 and Plexus
summary: Vice President C. P. Radhakrishnan launched 'Gnani Artha', a sovereign AI stack developed by the private firm GNANI AI, comprising the large language model Evon 3.3 and the Plexus platform that links AI with institutions and real-world work. In his address, he praised India's growing AI capabilities, linked them to the IndiaAI Mission and government initiatives, and called for India to become a creator rather than just a consumer of technology.

title: Vice President Shri C. P. Radhakrishnan to visit Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, Keralam and Lakshadweep from August 29–31
summary: The Vice President of India, Shri C. P. Radhakrishnan, will visit Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, Kerala and Lakshadweep from August 29-31, 2026. His itinerary includes attending institutional anniversary events, a fisheries outreach programme, an industry-academia summit, and inaugurating Onam-related cultural celebrations in Kerala.

title: Appointment of Judge and Additional Judges in the Calcutta High Court
summary: The President of India, acting on consultation with the Chief Justice of India, has appointed Justice Biswaroop Chowdhury as a permanent Judge of the Calcutta High Court. Six other Additional Judges of the Calcutta High Court—Justices Prasenjit Biswas, Uday Kumar, Ajay Kumar Gupta, Supratim Bhattacharya, Partha Sarathi Chatterjee, and Md. Shabbar Rashidi—have been given a fresh six-month term as Additional Judges effective 31.08.2026.

title: From Financial Inclusion to Economic Empowerment: Union Minister Smt. Annpurna Devi Hails 12 Years of the Pradhan Mantri Jan-Dhan Yojana

ministry.name: Ministry of Women and Child Development

summary: Union Minister Annpurna Devi marked the 12th anniversary of the Pradhan Mantri Jan-Dhan Yojana (PMJDY), highlighting that over 59 crore accounts have been opened, 56% held by women and 78% in rural/small-town areas. She noted deposits have crossed Rs. 3.1 lakh crore and Rs. 53 lakh crore has been transferred via Direct Benefit Transfer using the JAM (Jan Dhan-Aadhaar-Mobile) trinity.
syllabus_topics: GS Paper 2 - Government Policies and Interventions

title: DDWS urges States/UTs to facilitate student participation from local academic institutions under JJM 2.0
summary: The Department of Drinking Water & Sanitation (DDWS) has urged States and UTs to involve local colleges, universities and schools in documenting and studying best practices under Jal Jeevan Mission (JJM) 2.0. States are asked to organise student tours to water infrastructure sites like treatment plants and SCADA-enabled systems, and publish case studies through academic and institutional platforms. The initiative targets at least one student tour and one published case study per district by end of September 2026.

title: Good Corporate Governance Is Central to India’s Development: Dr. Jitendra Singh

ministry.name: Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances & Pensions

summary: A delegation from the Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI) met Union Minister Dr. Jitendra Singh to invite him as Guest of Honour for the 26th ICSI National Awards for Excellence in Corporate Governance in 2027. The Minister spoke on the importance of corporate governance and the role of Company Secretaries, while ICSI briefed him on its membership (over 80,000 members, ~250,000 students) and initiatives including Panchayat governance manuals and digitalisation of institutional processes.

title: Inaugural India-Kuwait Joint Defence Committee Meeting Held in New Delhi
summary: The inaugural India-Kuwait Joint Defence Committee (JDC) meeting was held in New Delhi on 28 August 2026, co-chaired by Joint Secretary Amitabh Prasad and Brigadier General Raed Alsakran. Both sides agreed to deepen defence cooperation in training, military exercises, military medicine, staff talks, defence industry, and R&D, operationalising the 2024 India-Kuwait Defence Cooperation MoU. The Kuwaiti delegation also visited the National War Memorial and DPSU Bhawan for industry interactions.

title: President of India, Smt. Droupadi Murmu, celebrates Raksha Bandhan with students from schools across the country at Rashtrapati Bhavan
summary: President Droupadi Murmu celebrated Raksha Bandhan with 122 participants, including 89 students and 32 teachers (13 with special needs) from 17 states, one Union Territory, KVS and NVS, at Rashtrapati Bhavan. She urged students to extend the values of love and protection to the environment by tying rakhis on trees. The students also toured Pradhan Mantri Sangrahalaya, Amrit Udyan, and have further visits planned to a Buddha relics exhibition, National Science Centre, National War Memorial and India Gate.

title: NHRC, India to hold 'Open Hearing and Camp Sitting' at Gandhinagar, Gujarat on 2nd and 3rd September 2026
summary: The National Human Rights Commission (NHRC) will hold a two-day 'Open Hearing and Camp Sitting' at Gandhinagar, Gujarat on 2-3 September 2026. Chairperson Justice V. Ramasubramanian and Members Justice (Dr.) Bidyut Ranjan Sarangi and Smt. Vijaya Bharathi Sayani will hear cases of alleged human rights violations, including bonded labour cases, and interact with state officials, civil society and NGOs.

title: Union Home Minister and Minister of Cooperation Shri Amit Shah celebrates auspicious festival of Raksha Bandhan in Ahmedabad with girls from his parliamentary constituency who are suffering from Type-1 diabetes
summary: Union Home Minister Amit Shah celebrated Raksha Bandhan in Ahmedabad with girls from his Gandhinagar parliamentary constituency who suffer from Type-1 diabetes. He highlighted a local initiative providing free lifelong insulin to children aged 0-18 with Type-1 diabetes in his constituency, supported by a screening-diagnosis-treatment-monitoring-follow-up system. He described it as reflecting the government's commitment to 'Service, Compassion, and Security'.

title: MCA convenes ‘Tech for Professionals’ Workshop on Building India’s Digital Infrastructure for Professional Services
summary: The Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA), with the Indian Institute of Corporate Affairs (IICA), held a one-day 'Tech for Professionals' Workshop in New Delhi on 27 August 2026 to discuss building shared digital infrastructure for India's professional services ecosystem (audit, compliance, consulting). The event featured addresses by MCA Secretary Pallavi Jain Govil and IICA DG Gyaneshwar Kumar Singh, and four panel sessions with regulators, technology firms and professional bodies discussing a proposed Digital Public Good (DPG) framework with three layers: technology access, learning/capability development, and knowledge/practice infrastructure. The workshop follows a Sub-Committee on Digital Public Good constituted by MCA in April 2026, which submitted its recommendations in May 2026.

title: Prime Minister condoles the passing of His Majesty King Harald V of Norway
summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi condoled the death of King Harald V of Norway, recalling their meeting during his visit to Norway earlier in the year. Modi expressed condolences to the Royal Family and people of Norway via a post on X.

title: Indian Pharmacopoeia Commission (IPC) Organises Scientific Conclave on Advancing Quality, Safety and Innovation in Drugs and Phytopharmaceuticals at NIPER Guwahati

ministry.name: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare

summary: The Indian Pharmacopoeia Commission (IPC) held its first Northeast scientific conclave on phytopharmaceuticals at NIPER Guwahati on 27 August 2026, bringing together regulators, academia and scientific institutions. At the event, IPC launched its first-ever seven Indian Pharmacopoeia Phytochemical Reference Standards (IPPRS) and five Indian Pharmacopoeia Botanical Reference Standards (IPBRS), covering compounds like Andrographolide, Capsaicin and Eugenol, and plants like Tinospora cordifolia and Ocimum sanctum. The initiative aims to strengthen scientific standardisation and quality assurance of plant-based medicines.

title: Department of Posts, Delhi Circle to Hold Monthly Dak Adalat on September 18th 2026
summary: The Department of Posts, Delhi Circle will hold a Monthly Dak Adalat on September 18, 2026, at Meghdoot Bhawan, New Delhi, to resolve pending postal service grievances. Only complaints previously raised at the Divisional Level Dak Adalat but still unresolved will be taken up, and they must be submitted to the Assistant Director (CS) by September 2, 2026.

title: High-Powered Task Force Invites Suggestions on Reforms in Public Examinations

ministry.name: Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances & Pensions

summary: The Government of India has set up a High-Powered Task Force (HPTF) chaired by Nandan Nilekani to recommend comprehensive reforms in the conduct, security, design and governance of public examinations, including those held by the National Testing Agency (NTA). The Task Force has invited suggestions from students, parents, teachers, examination bodies, technology experts, industry and civil society on issues ranging from exam security and malpractice prevention to inclusive access and student well-being. Submissions can be made in English, Hindi and regional languages via website, phone, WhatsApp or email by 13 September 2026.

title: DoT and C-DOT Sign Agreement to Establish End-to-End Optical Network Testbed for Indigenous Optical Communication Technologies
summary: DoT and C-DOT signed a five-year agreement on 27 August 2026 to establish an End-to-End Optical Network Test Bed at C-DOT's New Delhi campus. The DoT-funded facility will test and validate indigenous optical communication technologies developed by Indian startups and industry, bridging the gap between lab research and market-ready products. The project runs in two phases: infrastructure Set-up (Years 1-2) and Operations & Maintenance (Years 3-5), covering Optical Core, Optical Access and Quantum Security technologies.

title: India's Index of industrial production records growth of 6.7% in July 2026.
summary: India's Index of Industrial Production (IIP) grew 6.7% year-on-year in July 2026, driven by 7.3% growth in manufacturing and 8.7% growth in Electricity & Gas Supply, though this was slower than June 2026's 7.3% growth. Mining & Quarrying contracted by 0.9%, while 19 of 23 manufacturing industry groups posted positive growth, led by electrical equipment (28.3%), motor vehicles (22.2%), and machinery (12.1%). Under Use-Based Classification, Capital Goods (16.1%) and Intermediate Goods (10.0%) led growth, while Consumer Non-durables contracted by 1.0%.

title: Union Minister Shri Pralhad Joshi to grace the 115th Foundation Day of National Test House in Bengaluru tomorrow

ministry.name: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food & Public Distribution

summary: The National Test House (NTH), under the Department of Consumer Affairs, is celebrating its 115th Foundation Day on 29 August 2026 at its Jakkuru Campus in Bengaluru, with Union Minister Pralhad Joshi as chief guest. The event will inaugurate a new NTH Bengaluru building and virtually launch several testing facilities across the country (Kolkata, Chennai, Jaipur, Varanasi) along with a new 'NTH Suvidha' mobile app for MSMEs and industry.

title: From Financial Challenges to an Academic Career: How NFSC Support Empowered Dr Janaki Sundararajan
summary: This PIB release is a human-interest story highlighting the National Fellowship for Scheduled Caste Students (NFSC) Scheme through the case of Dr Janaki Sundararajan, a scholar from Dindigul, Tamil Nadu. She received a Senior Research Fellowship of ₹35,000 per month under NFSC from September 2019, which helped her complete her Ph.D. between 2019 and 2024. She now works as a Guest Teacher at The Gandhigram Rural Institute (Deemed to be University).

title: NHRC, India takes suo motu cognizance of the reported non-serving of mid-day meals to students of Classes VI to VIII at a government school in Ballia district, Uttar Pradesh for two years
summary: NHRC has taken suo motu cognizance of a media report that students of Classes VI to VIII at a government school in Ballia district, Uttar Pradesh, were not served mid-day meals for two years despite false records showing 200 students being fed regularly. An inquiry found irregularities and alleged misappropriation of nearly Rs. 14 lakh, including underpayment of cooks and misuse of PM Poshan Abhiyan funds. NHRC has issued a notice to the Uttar Pradesh Chief Secretary seeking a detailed report within two weeks.

title: Ex-Mill Sugar Prices Decline by Around 20%; Retail Prices Begin Downward Movement

ministry.name: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food & Public Distribution

summary: The Government has reported a roughly 20% decline in ex-mill sugar prices and the beginning of a corresponding drop in retail prices, attributing the earlier price spike to hoarding and speculation rather than actual shortages. Physical verification found several mills holding stocks higher than declared and engaging in short-selling against their monthly quotas. From September, the Government will replace the monthly sugar quota system with a fortnightly allocation system requiring mills to sell at least 40% of their quota in the first week, alongside a mandatory seven-day dispatch rule, to improve supply chain movement ahead of the festive season.

title: NHRC, India takes suo motu cognizance of the reported deaths of at least 60 newborns during the first three weeks of August 2026 at Malda Medical College and Hospital in West Bengal
summary: The National Human Rights Commission (NHRC) has taken suo motu cognizance of media reports that at least 60 newborns died over the first three weeks of August 2026 at Malda Medical College and Hospital in West Bengal, with ten deaths reported on a single day. The Commission has issued a notice to the West Bengal Chief Secretary seeking a detailed report within two weeks. Media reports indicate 44 of the 60 deceased newborns were referrals from other medical facilities after their condition worsened.
syllabus_topics: GS Paper 2 - Statutory and Regulatory Bodies

title: Second Call for Applications Under ₹5,000 Crore PRIP Scheme to Boost Pharma & MedTech Innovation announced

ministry.name: Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilizers :Department of Pharmaceuticals

summary: The Department of Pharmaceuticals has opened the second call for applications under the ₹5,000 crore PRIP (Promotion of Research and Innovation in Pharma & MedTech) Scheme, inviting startups, MSMEs and industry to apply across two tracks: early-stage projects (TRL 1-3 to TRL 5, up to ₹5 crore support) and later-stage projects (TRL 4-6 upward, up to ₹100 crore support capped at 35% of project cost). The submission window on the PRIP portal opens by mid-September, and applicants from Round 1 are asked not to resubmit the same project.
syllabus_topics: GS Paper 2 - Government Policies and Interventions

title: Less procedural burden, wider global market access for Indian industry: Defence Export SOP and Open General Export Licence framework simplified to make India a trusted global manufacturing & export partner
summary: The Department of Defence Production has reformed the Defence Export Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) and Open General Export Licence (OGEL) framework to ease export procedures for Indian defence manufacturers. Key changes include dispensing with stakeholder consultation for non-lethal exports and for international tenders/exhibitions, consolidating three OGEL SOPs into one, extending OGEL validity from two to three years, and expanding country coverage from 41 to nearly all countries except sanctioned/sensitive ones. The reforms come as India's defence production hit a record Rs 1.78 lakh crore and defence exports reached Rs 38,424 crore in FY 2025-26.
syllabus_topics: GS Paper 2 - Government Policies and Interventions

title: Prime Minister shares glimpses of Raksha Bandhan celebrations at 7, Lok Kalyan Marg
summary: The Prime Minister's Office released images and social media posts from Prime Minister Narendra Modi's Raksha Bandhan celebrations held at his residence, 7 Lok Kalyan Marg. Modi shared festive greetings on X, wishing that the occasion strengthen bonds of affection and bring happiness and prosperity to all.

title: Highlights of Telecom Subscription Data at the end of July 2026
summary: The release presents TRAI-sourced telecom subscription data for India as of July 2026, showing total telephone subscribers at 1354.28 million with a monthly net addition of 6.20 million (0.46% growth). It details wireless/wireline splits, urban-rural distribution (58.83% urban, 41.17% rural share), tele-density figures (94.68% overall, 154.12% urban, 61.05% rural), broadband subscriber counts, and 15.98 million Mobile Number Portability requests during the month.

title: Prime Minister pays homage to Mahatma Ayyankali on his birth anniversary
summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi paid tribute to Mahatma Ayyankali on his birth anniversary on 28 August 2026. He praised Ayyankali as a pioneer of social justice who worked for the education of marginalised communities, upliftment of agricultural workers, and welfare of the poor.

title: Government Strengthens Monitoring and Timely Delivery of Scheduled Caste Welfare Schemes
summary: The Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment issued a statement describing how it monitors and ensures timely delivery of Scheduled Caste welfare schemes such as Post-Matric Scholarship, PM-AJAY, SHRESHTA, National Overseas Scholarship and skill-development programmes. It highlights mechanisms like Direct Benefit Transfer, SNA-SPARSH onboarding, Utilisation Certificates, social audits, third-party evaluations, Chintan Shivirs and regular Centre-State coordination used during FY2021-22 to FY2025-26. No new scheme, allocation figures or policy changes are announced.

title: Prime Minister pays tributes to Sree Narayana Guru on his birth anniversary
summary: The Prime Minister Narendra Modi paid tributes to Sree Narayana Guru on his birth anniversary via a post on X. He described the social reformer as a towering figure devoted to building a society based on dignity and compassion, highlighting his emphasis on education and learning.

title: Prime Minister highlights transformative impact of Jan Dhan Yojana
summary: On the occasion of 12 years of the Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY), Prime Minister Narendra Modi posted on social media platform X praising the scheme's 'unprecedented scale and transformative outcomes' in advancing financial inclusion. The release consists solely of this celebratory social media post with the hashtag #12YearsOfJanDhan, without any new data, statistics, or policy announcements.

title: Prime Minister extends Raksha Bandhan greetings
summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi extended greetings to the nation on the occasion of Raksha Bandhan. He wished that the festival bring happiness, prosperity and success, and prayed that the bond of love and trust it celebrates remains strong. The greeting was posted on X in Hindi.

title: Union Home Minister and Minister of Cooperation Shri Amit Shah extends heartfelt greetings to all on ‘World Sanskrit Day’
summary: Union Home Minister Amit Shah extended greetings to the nation on the occasion of World Sanskrit Day, praising Sanskrit as the foundational basis of India's knowledge tradition and culture, and honoring scholars who preserved the language. He also extended Raksha Bandhan greetings on the occasion of Sawan Purnima.

title: Prime Minister shares Sanskrit Subhashitam emphasizing the protective bond
summary: The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi, shared a Sanskrit Subhashitam (verse) on social media platform X highlighting the protective and auspicious power of 'Raksha', likely in connection with the Raksha Bandhan festival. The verse, addressed to Yudhishthira, describes the blessing as bringing victory, happiness, and prosperity including sons, health and wealth.

title: Prime Minister extends  greetings on World Sanskrit Day
summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi extended greetings on World Sanskrit Day, observed on Shravana Purnima. He praised Sanskrit as a continuous vehicle of India's knowledge, thought and creativity, and lauded those studying and teaching the language for preserving it for future generations.

title: Union Home Minister and Minister of Cooperation Shri Amit Shah pays tributes to Sree Narayana Guru Ji on his Jayanti
summary: Union Home Minister Amit Shah paid tribute on social media to Sree Narayana Guru Ji and Mahatma Ayyankali Ji on their respective Jayantis. He praised Sree Narayana Guru for promoting spirituality, knowledge, compassion and equality, and lauded Ayyankali Ji as a pioneering social reformer who advanced education and social justice in Kerala.

title: CTTC Bhubaneswar Lights up Young Minds:Trains Over 8,000 Engineering Students Through Summer Internship Programme 2026
summary: CTTC Bhubaneswar, under the Ministry of MSME, conducted a four-week Summer Internship Training Programme in May-June 2026, training 8,083 engineering students from 22 states/UTs and 26 international students from Sudan and Yemen. The programme covered 39 domains across Mechanical, Electronics, IT, Civil and emerging technologies like AI-ML, IoT and Additive Manufacturing, with Mechanical (3,193) and AI training (1,748) seeing the highest participation.

title: Nuclear Energy Technology in India
summary: This PIB backgrounder outlines India's nuclear energy strategy centred on the indigenous three-stage nuclear power programme designed to transition from uranium to thorium-based fuel cycles. India currently operates 24 reactors (8.78 GW installed capacity) with nine more under construction, and aims for 100 GW of nuclear capacity by 2047 through initiatives like the Nuclear Energy Mission (2025-26, with ₹20,000 crore for Small Modular Reactors) and the SHANTI Act, 2025. It also highlights the April 2026 milestone of the Prototype Fast Breeder Reactor at Kalpakkam achieving first criticality, marking the start of Stage 2 of the programme.

title: Nuclear Energy in India
summary: This PIB backgrounder outlines India's nuclear energy programme, covering its role in power generation, safety architecture, and applications beyond electricity such as healthcare, agriculture, food preservation, semiconductors, and green hydrogen. India currently operates 24 reactors across seven sites with 8.78 GW installed capacity, with nine more under construction, and aims for 100 GW by 2047 under the Nuclear Energy Mission for Viksit Bharat, backed by the SHANTI Act, 2025 and ₹20,000 crore budgeted for indigenous Small Modular Reactors. It also highlights safety systems (Defence in Depth, ALARA principle, AERB regulations) and recent technological milestones like the world's first nuclear process-heat hydrogen facility at Kalpakkam and an indigenous Boron-11 enrichment facility for semiconductors.

title: DRI seizes 76 kg methamphetamine tablets in two operations along North-Eastern frontier
summary: The Directorate of Revenue Intelligence (DRI) seized a total of 76 kg of suspected methamphetamine tablets in two separate operations along India's North-Eastern frontier. On 25 August 2026, 56 kg was recovered from a concealed cavity in a truck near the Assam-Manipur border, while on 18 August 2026, 20 kg was seized from a car near Aizawl, Mizoram, with drugs suspected to have been smuggled from Myanmar via the Zokhawthar-Champhai sector. Two persons were arrested under the NDPS Act, 1985.

title: Ministry Finalises Three Short Films to Strengthen Awareness against Substance Abuse
summary: The Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment has finalised three 60-second short films to raise public awareness about substance abuse, covering early warning signs, the National De-addiction Helpline (14446), and the role of parents and teachers. These films support the Nasha Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan (NMBA), launched on 15 August 2020 under the National Action Plan for Drug Demand Reduction (NAPDDR).

title: PM SVANidhi Completes One Year of Restructuring: Expanding Credit, Digital Inclusion and Livelihoods Opportunities
summary: PM SVANidhi, the collateral-free micro-credit scheme for street vendors launched in June 2020, has completed one year of its restructured phase approved by the Cabinet on 27 August 2025, which extends lending till 31 March 2030 and targets 1.15 crore vendors including 50 lakh new beneficiaries. In this first year, 21.86 lakh loans worth ₹6,294 crore were disbursed to 10.56 lakh new beneficiaries, alongside new features such as a UPI-linked RuPay credit card, a digital lending platform, Street Food Hubs, and expansion to Census Towns. Since inception, the scheme has disbursed over 1.18 crore loans worth ₹19,171 crore to 78.68 lakh vendors.

title: OFFICER TRAINEES OF INDIAN FOREIGN SERVICE CALL ON THE PRESIDENT
summary: President Droupadi Murmu addressed Officer Trainees of the Indian Foreign Service (2025 batch) and two Bhutanese diplomats undergoing training at the Sushma Swaraj Institute of Foreign Service, who called on her at Rashtrapati Bhavan on 27 August 2026. She urged them to align India's diplomacy with national interests and citizens' aspirations, leverage emerging opportunities in investment, technology and renewable energy, engage beyond government with academia, diaspora and civil society, and uphold integrity while using technology without losing empathy.

title: National Conclave on Tribal Languages & Museums holds deliberations on Tribal Museums in Mysuru
summary: A National Conclave on Tribal Languages and Museums held in Mysuru brought together officials, experts and community representatives to discuss preservation of tribal cultural heritage through Tribal Museums and Tribal Freedom Fighter Museums (TFFMs). Sessions covered authentic storytelling, museum planning, contemporary display technologies, and community participation, drawing on the Tribal Museum Bhopal as a case study. Discussions also addressed sustainability through revenue-generation ideas like tribal-cuisine cafés and guest houses.

title: Raksha Mantri and Madhya Pradesh Chief Minister perform Bhoomi Pujan for T-Series Tanks Overhaul Project at Vehicle Factory, Jabalpur
summary: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh and Madhya Pradesh CM Mohan Yadav performed Bhoomi Pujan on 27 August 2026 for a Rs 472 crore T-Series Tank Overhaul Project at Vehicle Factory, Jabalpur, a unit of Armoured Vehicles Nigam Limited (AVNL). The facility will overhaul 80 T-72 and T-90 tanks annually, adding to the Heavy Vehicles Factory Avadi's existing capacity of 150 tanks per year, against the Army's requirement of 230 overhauled tanks annually. Singh highlighted India's rising defence production (Rs 1.80 lakh crore in FY2025-26, up from Rs 46,000 crore in 2014) and exports (about Rs 39,000 crore) as part of the Aatmanirbhar Bharat push in defence manufacturing.

title: LOK SABHA SPEAKER GREETS PEOPLE ON THE EVE OF RAKSHA BANDHAN
summary: Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla issued a greeting message to citizens on the eve of Raksha Bandhan, describing the festival as a symbol of India's family values and the bond between brothers and sisters. He called for protecting women's dignity, rights and dreams, and urged strengthening trust, harmony and equal opportunities for daughters within families and society.

title: दिल्ली में माता सुंदरी कॉलेज में खेलो इंडिया संवाद में केंद्रीय मंत्री श्री शिवराज सिंह चौहान ने की सहभागिता
summary: Union Minister Shivraj Singh Chauhan participated in the 'Khelo India Samvad' event with PM Modi's nationwide programme, interacting with students at Mata Sundari College for Women, Delhi. Students offered suggestions on sports psychology modules, rural sports infrastructure, financial support for economically weaker athletes, and family sensitization workshops. The minister administered a drug-free India pledge and assured that viable suggestions would be forwarded to relevant departments.

title: Commerce and Industry Minister Shri Piyush Goyal Concludes Japan Visit; Calls for Greater Japanese Investment and Stronger Industrial Partnerships with India
summary: Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal completed an official visit to Japan (Tokyo, Nagoya, Osaka) aimed at boosting Japanese investment and industrial partnerships with India. He met over 30 major Japanese companies and financial institutions, chaired roundtables on capital goods, semiconductors/AI, startups and FIIs, and pushed for the JPY 10 trillion Japanese private investment target agreed during PM Modi's 2025 Japan visit. He also presented India's six-pillar semiconductor strategy, with India's semiconductor demand projected to reach USD 150 billion by 2032.

title: Tecnam P2006T twin-engine aircraft meets with accident near Ganga Barrage in Kanpur
summary: A Tecnam P2006T twin-engine training aircraft (VT-NBV), operated by Garg Aviation Ltd. of Kanpur, crashed near Ganga Barrage, about 5 NM from Kanpur Civil Airport, on the afternoon of 27 August 2026. Both persons on board, a trainee pilot and an instructor, died in the accident. A DGCA team has been dispatched to the site, and the AAIB will conduct a detailed investigation into the cause.

title: 12 Years of PM Jan Dhan Yojana
summary: This PIB backgrounder marks 12 years of the Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PM-JDY), launched in 2014 as India's national financial inclusion mission. It notes that PM-JDY accounts have grown from 14.72 crore in 2015 to 59.09 crore as of 19 August 2026, with 32.92 crore female beneficiaries, deposits rising nearly 20x to ₹3,16,514 crore, and 41.29 crore RuPay cards issued. It also details scheme features such as zero minimum balance, RuPay accident insurance cover, overdraft facility, and linkage to social security schemes like PMJJBY, PMSBY, APY and MUDRA.

title: Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi participates in Khelo India Dialogue
summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi addressed the Khelo India Dialogue via video conference ahead of National Sports Day (August 29), reiterating his Independence Day sports vision for a Viksit Bharat. He highlighted India's non-participation in nearly half of Olympic sporting disciplines, referenced a national Talent Hunt for children aged 5-15 aimed at the 2036 Olympics, and praised Para Athletes and grassroots sports culture.

title: English rendering of PM's address at the Khelo India Dialogue via video conferencing
summary: In his address at the Khelo India Samvad (dialogue) via video conference, PM Modi reiterated India's sports vision announced from the Red Fort on 15 August, highlighting that India currently competes in only about half of Olympic sporting disciplines and announcing a talent-hunt campaign to identify sportspersons aged 5-15 in preparation for the 2036 Olympics. He greeted National Sports Day (29 August, Major Dhyan Chand's birth anniversary) and praised para-athletes and India's growing sports culture, while urging youth to submit ideas on talent development and sports governance for policy inclusion.
syllabus_topics: GS Paper 2 - Government Policies and Interventions

title: Rajbhasha Utkrishtta Sammaan to Department of Administrative Reforms and Public Grievances in the category of Ministries/Departments with less than 300 personnel for the year 2025-26, by the Department of Official Language, Ministry of Home Affairs

ministry.name: Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances & Pensions

summary: The Department of Administrative Reforms and Public Grievances (DARPG) has been selected for the 'Rajbhasha Utkrishtta Sammaan' for 2025-26 by the Department of Official Language, Ministry of Home Affairs, recognizing its continuous excellence in implementing the Official Language policy. DARPG had earlier won the Rajbhasha Kirti Puraskar (First) for two consecutive years, 2023-24 and 2024-25, but rules bar a third consecutive first prize, so this special award was created to honor its ongoing performance. The award will be presented at the Hindi Diwas Sammelan in Navi Mumbai on September 14, 2026.

title: DAANVEER: Ministry of Panchayati Raj Calls for Public Participation to Strengthen Digital Infrastructure in Gram Panchayats
summary: The Ministry of Panchayati Raj has launched 'DAANVEER', a crowdsourcing initiative allowing citizens, NGOs, CSR partners and the diaspora to donate desktop computers directly to verified Gram Panchayats via the Meri Panchayat App. Donors are redirected to the ONDC-enabled DigiHaat marketplace where Panchayat delivery details are auto-populated, payment is made digitally, and the donation is tracked end-to-end, with a digital Certificate of Appreciation issued after acknowledgement. As of 27 August 2026, 75 donations have been made under the initiative, which complements infrastructure support under the Rashtriya Gram Swaraj Abhiyan (RGSA).
syllabus_topics: GS Paper 2 - Government Policies and Interventions

title: NHRC, India takessuo motucognizance of the reported death of three newborns and injuries to four others due to a fire incident at the Sick Newborn Care Unit of the District Women's Hospital at Amravati, Maharashtra
summary: The National Human Rights Commission (NHRC) has taken suo motu cognizance of a fire incident at the Sick Newborn Care Unit of the District Women's Hospital in Amravati, Maharashtra on 24 August 2026, in which three newborns died and four were injured, reportedly due to a ventilator machine blast. The Commission has issued a notice to the Maharashtra Chief Secretary seeking a detailed report within two weeks, covering the health status of injured infants and disbursement of announced compensation. Nine babies were present in the unit when the incident occurred, with one injured infant reported in critical condition.
syllabus_topics: GS Paper 2 - Statutory and Regulatory Bodies

title: NHRC, India takessuo motucognizance of the reported death of a woman raped during a diagnostic test at Civil Hospital of Panipat, Haryana
summary: The National Human Rights Commission (NHRC) has taken suo motu cognizance of media reports that a 57-year-old terminally ill woman was raped by a CT scan machine operator at Civil Hospital, Panipat, Haryana on 16 August 2026, and subsequently died during treatment at PGIMS Rohtak on 18 August 2026. The Commission has issued notices to the Haryana Chief Secretary and the Panipat Superintendent of Police seeking a detailed report within two weeks.
syllabus_topics: GS Paper 2 - Statutory and Regulatory Bodies

title: NHRC, India takessuo motucognizance of reported burn injuries to a woman after people allegedly poured boiling water on her, branding her a witch in Bhojpur village, Garhwa district, Jharkhand
summary: The National Human Rights Commission (NHRC) has taken suo motu cognizance of a media report that a woman suffered 40% burn injuries after villagers in Bhojpur, Garhwa district, Jharkhand, poured boiling water on her after branding her a witch. NHRC has issued notices to the Garhwa District Magistrate and Superintendent of Police seeking a detailed report within two weeks, including the victim's health status and any compensation paid. The victim is currently hospitalised and an investigation is underway.

title: PM Jan Dhan Yojana Completes 12 Years of Transforming India’s Financial Inclusion Landscape
summary: The Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY), launched on 28 August 2014, completed 12 years, with 59.09 crore accounts opened as on 19th August 2026 holding deposits of ₹3.17 lakh crore. About 56% of account holders are women and 78% of accounts are in rural or semi-urban areas, with 41.29 crore RuPay cards issued. The scheme, anchored in the JAM (Jan Dhan-Aadhaar-Mobile) trinity, enables diversion-proof direct benefit transfers and has expanded access to insurance, overdraft facilities, and pension schemes for the underprivileged.

title: Prime Minister condoles the passing of Shri A. Balakrishnan Ji
summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi condoled the death of Shri A. Balakrishnan Ji, who served as the All India President of Vivekananda Kendra. Modi noted that Balakrishnan Ji dedicated over five decades to the ideals of Swami Vivekananda, had a deep association with the Northeast, and contributed to educational, social and nation-building activities.

title: India highlights its Science-based advances in Snow Leopard Conservation including Population Estimation, Radio Telemetry and Genetic Analysis, at Moscow Roundtable Meeting

ministry.name: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change

summary: India participated in the Russian-Indian Roundtable Meeting on Snow Leopard Study and Conservation, held on 26 August 2026 in Moscow under the framework of a December 2025 Partnership Agreement between the 'Irbis' Association and the International Big Cat Alliance (IBCA). The Indian delegation, including officials from the Wildlife Institute of India, presented India's scientific advances in snow leopard population estimation, radio telemetry, and genetic analysis. The meeting brought together Russian environmental bodies, research institutions, and experts to discuss collaborative conservation and monitoring approaches.

title: Prime Minister shares Sanskrit Subhashitam emphasizing on diligence, wisdom and noble conduct
summary: The Prime Minister Narendra Modi shared a Sanskrit Subhashitam on social media platform X emphasizing wisdom, diligence and noble conduct in building a virtuous society. The verse urges individuals to follow the path of light and wisdom while remaining steadfast in their efforts.

title: Minister of State for Commerce and Industry and Electronics & Information Technology Shri Jitin Prasada Concludes Official Visit to Morocco; Co-Chairs 7th India–Morocco Joint Commission
summary: Union Minister of State Jitin Prasada visited Morocco from 24-25 August 2026 and co-chaired the 7th India-Morocco Joint Commission with his counterpart Omar Hejira. The two sides agreed to double bilateral trade (currently around USD 4 billion in 2025) within five years, set up a Joint Working Group to explore a preferential trade agreement, and signed MoUs on food safety and cultural exchange. Prasada also visited the IMACID phosphate joint venture and invited Moroccan investment into India's AI, EV, renewable energy, healthcare and pharma sectors, with the 8th Joint Commission slated for New Delhi ahead of the 70th anniversary of diplomatic ties in 2027.

title: Prime Minister speaks to the Prime Minister of Nepal
summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi spoke with Nepal's Prime Minister Balendra Shah and conveyed condolences over the loss of lives caused by floods in Nepal. Modi expressed India's solidarity with the Nepalese people and assured that India is ready to provide humanitarian assistance, with Indian teams coordinating with Nepalese authorities on rescue and relief operations.

title: Commerce and Industry Minister Shri Piyush Goyal Highlights India’s Growing Startup Ecosystem at India–Japan Startup Roundtable in Tokyo
summary: Union Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal addressed an India–Japan Startup Roundtable in Tokyo, noting India has built nearly 250,000 startups over the past decade to become the world's third-largest startup ecosystem. He proposed a four-pillar framework for deeper India-Japan startup cooperation and highlighted a proposed second Fund of Funds of about US$1 billion focused on deep-tech enterprises. Around 40 Japanese companies and a 222-member Indian business delegation participated, with discussions covering AI, semiconductors, healthcare, space, defence and advanced manufacturing as priority areas for collaboration.

title: Capacity Building of Mind, Alongside Skills, equally Essential for India to Remain Globally Relevant: says Union Minister Jitendra Singh

ministry.name: Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances & Pensions

summary: Union Minister Dr. Jitendra Singh, speaking at a roundtable on capacity building organised by Nalanda University, said capacity building of the mind, not just skills, is essential for India to remain globally relevant. He called for a whole-of-society approach involving government, private sector and civil society, referenced the iGOT platform's 40 lakh registered users, and urged greater philanthropy and private participation in research and innovation, citing the National Research Foundation and the ₹1 lakh crore RDI funding initiative.

title: EPFO Releases August 2026 Pension in Keralam Ahead of Onam
summary: EPFO credited the August 2026 pension to 4,40,901 pensioners in the Keralam Zone on 26 August 2026, ahead of schedule, to help beneficiaries celebrate Onam. The disbursement was made through EPFO's Centralized Pension Payment System (CPPS), which enables direct transfer to pensioners' bank accounts nationwide.

title: ICAT Issues First Compliance Certificate for 15-Metre Multi-Axle Sleeper Bus
summary: The International Centre for Automotive Technology (ICAT) in Manesar has issued its first-ever compliance certificate for a 15-metre multi-axle sleeper bus under AIS-119 and AIS-153 standards, in line with Central Motor Vehicles Rules provisions. The certificate was awarded to Synaty Automotive Pvt. Ltd. for a bus configuration offering 42 berths (fully sleeper) or 21 berths plus 42 seats (hybrid variant), aimed at long-distance passenger transport.

title: Prime Minister condoles loss of lives in a mishap in Suryapet, Telangana
summary: The Prime Minister expressed grief over loss of lives in a mishap in Suryapet, Telangana, and prayed for the speedy recovery of the injured. The condolence message was posted on X in both English and Telugu.

title: India’s Sugar Industry
summary: This PIB backgrounder explains India's sugar industry, noting sugarcane production reached 500 MMT in 2025-26 (up 43.5% over a decade), FRP for 2026-27 set at ₹365/quintal, and clarifies that a recent 15.6% monthly sugar price spike (₹48.18 to ₹55.70/kg) is due to lower production (306 LMT vs 343 LMT estimate), festive demand, weather damage, global supply tightness, and hoarding—not ethanol diversion, which has actually declined from 12% to 9%. It also lists government measures to curb hoarding and boost supply, including stock limits, duty-free raw sugar imports of 10 lakh MT, and advancing the crushing season to October 15, 2026.

title: LOKAYAN 2026 – INDIAN NAVAL SHIP SUDARSHINI DEPARTS LISBON AFTER THREE-DAY PORT CALL
summary: INS Sudarshini, the Indian Navy's sail training ship, completed a three-day port call at Lisbon, Portugal, concluding on 25 August 2026 as part of its Lokayan 26 transoceanic expedition. During the visit, the ship's Commanding Officer met senior Portuguese Navy officials, sea trainees visited the Portuguese Naval Academy, and a deck reception was held with diplomats and the Indian diaspora. The visit followed an earlier stop at Ponta Delgada and highlights ongoing maritime cooperation between India and Portugal.

title: IICT and Netflix to Support Next Generation of Indian Storytellers Through Scholarships Across 6 Programs
summary: IICT (Indian Institute of Creative Technologies) and Netflix have announced scholarships for 100 students, covering up to 80% of fees across six professional programmes in animation, VFX, comics, media technology and e-sports management. The initiative follows PM Modi's meeting with Netflix Co-CEO Ted Sarandos on 5 August 2026, which launched the Netflix India Storytelling Initiative aimed at building India's AVGC (Animation, Visual Effects, Gaming, Comics) talent pipeline. The scholarships are open to students and working professionals across India.

title: SIDBI organizes a conclave of the Heads of Regional Rural Banks (RRBs) on expanding SIDBI-RRB MSME Co-Lending arrangement
summary: SIDBI held a conclave on 25 August 2026 in New Delhi with heads of all 28 Regional Rural Banks (RRBs) to discuss expanding the SIDBI-RRB MSME Co-Lending arrangement. Chaired by DFS Secretary Sanjay Lohiya and attended by SIDBI CMD Manoj Mittal, the meeting focused on scaling up MSME credit in rural and semi-urban areas using SIDBI's underwriting expertise and RRBs' rural network. The arrangement uses a digital Co-Lending Origination Platform for faster, paperless loan sanctioning and disbursement, and is being expanded after a successful pilot at three RRBs.

title: Turning the Wheel of Heritage
summary: The Ancient Buddhist Site of Sarnath in Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, has been inscribed on the UNESCO World Heritage List at the 48th Session of the World Heritage Committee held in Busan, South Korea on 25 July 2026. The inscription, covering the Chaukhandi Stupa and the Archaeological Remains of Sarnath (including the Dhamek Stupa, Dharmarajika Stupa, Mulagandhakuti Vihara and the Ashokan Pillar), was made under criteria (iii) and (vi) of the World Heritage Convention. This takes India's total to 45 World Heritage properties (37 cultural, 7 natural, 1 mixed), placing it sixth globally and second in the Asia Pacific region.

title: Celebrating Grassroots Innovation at the Micro Food Processing Bazaar
summary: The Ministry of Food Processing Industries organised a PMFME (Pradhan Mantri Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises) Bazaar at the India Habitat Centre on 24-25 August 2026, bringing together micro food enterprises, SHGs, FPOs and cooperatives from 25 States and UTs to showcase traditional and value-added food products. The release profiles four PMFME beneficiaries—SHHE Foods (Bihar, makhana products), Tribalveda (Rajasthan, tribal jamun products), Soya Rich (Maharashtra, soya/tofu products) and Malati Food Products (Odisha, millets)—highlighting how the scheme's credit-linked capital subsidy (35% of project cost, up to ₹10 lakh) helped them upgrade machinery, formalise operations and scale sales significantly.

title: 7th High-Level Meeting between Indian Coast Guard and Vietnam Coast Guard held in Chennai
summary: The 7th High-Level Meeting between the Indian Coast Guard and Vietnam Coast Guard was held in Chennai on 25 August 2026 under the 2015 MoU on Coast Guard Cooperation. Co-chaired by DG Paramesh Sivamani (ICG) and Major General Luong Dinh Hung (VCG), talks covered search and rescue, maritime law enforcement, pollution response and capacity building. A joint exercise, SAHYOG-HOPTAC, is scheduled at sea on 27 August 2026.

title: PM to Address Youth at Khelo India Dialogue on 27th August
summary: PM Narendra Modi will address the Khelo India Dialogue on 27 August via video conferencing, organized by Mera Yuva Bharat (MY Bharat) as part of National Sports Day 2026 celebrations. The nationwide programme will involve youth at two colleges in every district and feature a 'Yuva Samvaad' structured around five themes: sports ecosystem improvement, 2036 Olympic preparation, youth leadership, Viksit Bharat, and a Nasha Mukt Yuva (drug-free youth) movement.

title: Prime Minister shares Sanskrit Subhashitam emphasizing on mutual learning and listening
summary: The Prime Minister Narendra Modi shared a Sanskrit Subhashitam (aphorism) on social media emphasizing the value of mutual learning and listening. The verse states that those who eagerly learn from and listen to one another are praised by the wise, remain free of selfish motives, and prosper in happiness. The post was made via his official X (Twitter) account on 26 August 2026.

title: Prime Minister extends greetings on Milad-un-Nabi
summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi extended greetings to the nation on the occasion of Milad-un-Nabi. He expressed hope that the festival would strengthen togetherness and spread joy, and wished that a spirit of kindness and social service would guide everyone. The greeting was posted on social media platform X on 26 August 2026.

title: Prime Minister extends greetings on Onam
summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi extended greetings to the nation on the occasion of Onam. He described Onam as a vibrant festival celebrated with great fervour in India and worldwide, and wished that it strengthen the spirit of happiness, togetherness and prosperity in society.

title: India and Seychelles Convene High-Level Bilateral Meeting to Strengthen Strategic Cooperation in Fisheries, Aquaculture, and the Blue Economy

ministry.name: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry & Dairying

summary: India's Department of Fisheries hosted a high-level bilateral meeting with Seychelles on 25 August, led by Secretary Dr. Abhilaksh Likhi and Seychelles' Minister H.E. Wallace Cosgrow, to strengthen cooperation in fisheries, aquaculture, and the blue economy. India shared that national fish production has reached 19.7 million tonnes with seafood exports worth USD 8.46 billion. The two sides discussed mariculture, tuna fisheries, hatchery development, AI-based harvest management, and monitoring/surveillance systems, with Seychelles proposing a dedicated bilateral MoU on fisheries and aquaculture.

title: India Calls for Community-Led Restoration of Rangelands at UNCCD CoP17 in Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia

ministry.name: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change

summary: At UNCCD CoP17 in Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia, Union Environment Minister Bhupender Yadav highlighted India's approach to rangeland restoration, stressing pastoralists as custodians rather than beneficiaries. He cited India's use of Satellite-based Desertification and Land Degradation Atlases, recognition of grazing and community forest resource rights, and traditional systems like Rajasthan's Orans (around 25,000 sacred groves covering 0.6 million hectares) as models of community stewardship. He also referenced Cheetah reintroduction and its proposed expansion into Banni grasslands, and called for enhanced international finance and South-South cooperation for rangeland restoration.
